concepts.title: The Number Line
concepts.lesson: A number line puts every number in order by distance and direction from zero. Moving right increases a value and moving left decreases it.

oer.title: OpenStax Elementary Algebra 2e, 1.1 Introduction to Whole Numbers

concepts.title: Comparing Integers
concepts.lesson: On a number line, the integer farther to the right is greater. Negative numbers get smaller as their distance from zero grows.

oer.title: OpenStax Elementary Algebra 2e, 1.3 Add and Subtract Integers

concepts.title: Absolute Value
concepts.lesson: Absolute value is a number's distance from zero, so it is never negative. Both 5 and -5 are five units from zero.

oer.title: OpenStax Elementary Algebra 2e, 1.8 The Real Numbers

concepts.title: Adding and Subtracting Integers
concepts.lesson: Adding a negative moves left and subtracting a negative moves right. Keep the sign of the larger absolute value when the signs differ.

oer.title: OpenStax Elementary Algebra 2e, 1.3 Add and Subtract Integers

concepts.title: Multiplying and Dividing Integers
concepts.lesson: A product or quotient is positive when the signs match and negative when they differ. Division by zero is undefined.

oer.title: OpenStax Elementary Algebra 2e, 1.4 Multiply and Divide Integers

concepts.title: Equivalent Fractions
concepts.lesson: Multiplying or dividing the numerator and denominator by the same nonzero number keeps a fraction's value. Simplify by removing common factors.

oer.title: OpenStax Elementary Algebra 2e, 1.5 Visualize Fractions

concepts.title: Adding and Subtracting Fractions
concepts.lesson: Fractions can be added or subtracted only after they share a denominator. Rewrite each fraction, combine the numerators, then simplify.

oer.title: OpenStax Elementary Algebra 2e, 1.6 Add and Subtract Fractions

concepts.title: Multiplying and Dividing Fractions
concepts.lesson: Multiply fractions across, then simplify. To divide by a fraction, multiply by its reciprocal.

oer.title: OpenStax Elementary Algebra 2e, 1.5 Visualize Fractions

concepts.title: Decimals and Percents
concepts.lesson: A percent is a fraction out of 100. Move the decimal two places to switch between decimal and percent form.

oer.title: OpenStax Elementary Algebra 2e, 1.7 Decimals

concepts.title: Order of Operations
concepts.lesson: Evaluate parentheses first, then exponents, then multiplication and division left to right, then addition and subtraction left to right.

oer.title: OpenStax Elementary Algebra 2e, 1.1 Introduction to Whole Numbers

concepts.title: Exponents
concepts.lesson: An exponent records repeated multiplication: 2^4 means 2 times itself four times. The base is the repeated factor.

oer.title: OpenStax Elementary Algebra 2e, 6.2 Use Multiplication Properties of Exponents

concepts.title: Square Roots
concepts.lesson: The square root asks which nonnegative number squares to the radicand. Squares and square roots undo each other.

oer.title: OpenStax Elementary Algebra 2e, 9.1 Simplify and Use Square Roots

concepts.title: Properties of Real Numbers
concepts.lesson: The commutative, associative, identity, inverse, and distributive properties let you rewrite expressions without changing their value.

oer.title: OpenStax Elementary Algebra 2e, 1.9 Properties of Real Numbers

concepts.title: Proportions
concepts.lesson: A proportion states that two ratios are equal. Cross products are equal, which turns a proportion into an equation.

oer.title: OpenStax Elementary Algebra 2e, 8.7 Solve Proportion and Similar Figure Applications

concepts.title: Percent Change
concepts.lesson: Percent change compares the amount of change with the original amount. Divide the change by the original, then multiply by 100.

oer.title: OpenStax Elementary Algebra 2e, 3.2 Solve Percent Applications

concepts.title: Variables and Expressions
concepts.lesson: A variable stands for a number that can change. An algebraic expression combines variables, numbers, and operations without an equals sign.

oer.title: OpenStax Elementary Algebra 2e, 1.2 Use the Language of Algebra

concepts.title: Evaluating Expressions
concepts.lesson: To evaluate an expression, substitute the given value for each variable and follow the order of operations.

oer.title: OpenStax Elementary Algebra 2e, 1.2 Use the Language of Algebra

concepts.title: Combining Like Terms
concepts.lesson: Like terms have the same variable factors and exponents. Combine their coefficients while leaving the variable part unchanged.

oer.title: OpenStax Elementary Algebra 2e, 6.1 Add and Subtract Polynomials

concepts.title: The Distributive Property
concepts.lesson: Multiplying a sum multiplies each term inside the parentheses: a(b + c) = ab + ac. Watch the sign of each term.

oer.title: OpenStax Elementary Algebra 2e, 6.3 Multiply Polynomials

concepts.title: Simplifying Expressions
concepts.lesson: Simplify by distributing first, then combining like terms. A simplified expression has no repeated like terms or unnecessary parentheses.

oer.title: OpenStax Elementary Algebra 2e, 6.1 Add and Subtract Polynomials

concepts.title: Translating Words to Algebra
concepts.lesson: Words such as sum, difference, product, and quotient signal operations. Define the unknown first, then build the expression piece by piece.

oer.title: OpenStax Elementary Algebra 2e, 3.1 Use a Problem-Solving Strategy

concepts.title: One-Step Equations with Addition
concepts.lesson: Undo an added or subtracted constant by applying the inverse operation to both sides of the equation.

oer.title: OpenStax Elementary Algebra 2e, 2.1 Subtraction and Addition Properties of Equality

concepts.title: One-Step Equations with Multiplication
concepts.lesson: Undo multiplication by dividing both sides by the coefficient. Undo division by multiplying both sides by the divisor.

oer.title: OpenStax Elementary Algebra 2e, 2.2 Division and Multiplication Properties of Equality

concepts.title: Two-Step Equations
concepts.lesson: Solve in reverse order of operations: undo addition or subtraction first, then undo multiplication or division. Keep both sides balanced.

oer.title: OpenStax Elementary Algebra 2e, 2.4 Use a General Strategy to Solve Linear Equations

concepts.title: Variables on Both Sides
concepts.lesson: Collect variable terms on one side and constant terms on the other by adding or subtracting the same quantity from both sides.

oer.title: OpenStax Elementary Algebra 2e, 2.3 Variables and Constants on Both Sides

concepts.title: Equations with Fractions
concepts.lesson: Multiply every term by the least common denominator to clear fractions, then solve the resulting whole-number equation.

oer.title: OpenStax Elementary Algebra 2e, 2.5 Solve Equations with Fractions or Decimals

concepts.title: Literal Equations
concepts.lesson: A literal equation contains several variables. Isolate the requested variable using the same inverse operations.

oer.title: OpenStax Elementary Algebra 2e, 2.6 Solve a Formula for a Specific Variable

concepts.title: Linear Word Problems
concepts.lesson: Translate the situation into an equation, define the unknown, solve, and check that the answer fits the story.

oer.title: OpenStax Elementary Algebra 2e, 3.1 Use a Problem-Solving Strategy

concepts.title: Solving Linear Inequalities
concepts.lesson: Solve inequalities like equations, but reverse the inequality sign when multiplying or dividing both sides by a negative number.

oer.title: OpenStax Elementary Algebra 2e, 2.7 Solve Linear Inequalities

concepts.title: Compound Inequalities
concepts.lesson: A compound inequality joins two conditions with and or or. Apply the same operation to every part, or solve each part separately.

oer.title: OpenStax Intermediate Algebra 2e, 2.6 Solve Compound Inequalities

concepts.title: Absolute Value Equations
concepts.lesson: An absolute value equation can split into two cases because the inside expression may be positive or negative. Check each solution.

oer.title: OpenStax Intermediate Algebra 2e, 2.7 Solve Absolute Value Inequalities

concepts.title: The Coordinate Plane
concepts.lesson: The coordinate plane pairs a horizontal x-value with a vertical y-value. Four quadrants are defined by the signs of those coordinates.

oer.title: OpenStax Elementary Algebra 2e, 4.1 Use the Rectangular Coordinate System

concepts.title: Plotting Points
concepts.lesson: Start at the origin, move horizontally by the x-coordinate, then vertically by the y-coordinate. The order of the pair matters.

oer.title: OpenStax Elementary Algebra 2e, 4.1 Use the Rectangular Coordinate System

concepts.title: Domain and Range
concepts.lesson: The domain is the set of input values and the range is the set of output values. List each value once, in order.

oer.title: OpenStax Intermediate Algebra 2e, 3.5 Relations and Functions

concepts.title: Slope of a Line
concepts.lesson: Slope is vertical change divided by horizontal change between two points. It measures both steepness and direction.

oer.title: OpenStax Elementary Algebra 2e, 4.4 Understand Slope of a Line

concepts.title: Slope-Intercept Form
concepts.lesson: In y = mx + b, m is the slope and b is the y-intercept. This form makes graphing and interpreting a line direct.

oer.title: OpenStax Elementary Algebra 2e, 4.5 Use the Slope-Intercept Form

concepts.title: Graphing Linear Equations
concepts.lesson: A linear equation graphs as a straight line. Two points determine the line, and a third point checks the work.

oer.title: OpenStax Elementary Algebra 2e, 4.2 Graph Linear Equations in Two Variables

concepts.title: Point-Slope Form
concepts.lesson: Point-slope form y - y1 = m(x - x1) builds a line from one point and its slope. Distribute and solve for y to reach slope-intercept form.

oer.title: OpenStax Elementary Algebra 2e, 4.6 Find the Equation of a Line

concepts.title: Parallel and Perpendicular Lines
concepts.lesson: Parallel lines share a slope. Perpendicular slopes are negative reciprocals whose product is -1.

oer.title: OpenStax Intermediate Algebra 2e, 3.3 Find the Equation of a Line

concepts.title: x- and y-Intercepts
concepts.lesson: Set y = 0 to find the x-intercept and x = 0 to find the y-intercept. Intercepts are useful graphing anchors.

oer.title: OpenStax Elementary Algebra 2e, 4.3 Graph with Intercepts

concepts.title: Systems by Substitution
concepts.lesson: Solve one equation for a variable, substitute that expression into the other equation, and solve the resulting single-variable equation.

oer.title: OpenStax Elementary Algebra 2e, 5.2 Solving Systems by Substitution

concepts.title: Systems by Elimination
concepts.lesson: Add or subtract equations to eliminate a variable. Multiply an equation first when the coefficients do not already match.

oer.title: OpenStax Elementary Algebra 2e, 5.3 Solve Systems by Elimination

concepts.title: Product Rule for Exponents
concepts.lesson: When multiplying powers with the same base, add the exponents: x^a * x^b = x^(a+b).

oer.title: OpenStax Elementary Algebra 2e, 6.2 Multiplication Properties of Exponents

concepts.title: Quotient Rule for Exponents
concepts.lesson: When dividing powers with the same base, subtract the exponents: x^a / x^b = x^(a-b) for x not zero.

oer.title: OpenStax Elementary Algebra 2e, 6.5 Divide Monomials

concepts.title: Power Rule for Exponents
concepts.lesson: A power raised to a power multiplies the exponents: (x^a)^b = x^(ab). Apply the outer exponent to every factor inside.

oer.title: OpenStax Elementary Algebra 2e, 6.2 Multiplication Properties of Exponents

concepts.title: Negative and Zero Exponents
concepts.lesson: A nonzero base to the zero power is 1. A negative exponent moves the power to the denominator: x^-a = 1/x^a.

oer.title: OpenStax Elementary Algebra 2e, 6.7 Integer Exponents and Scientific Notation

concepts.title: Scientific Notation
concepts.lesson: Scientific notation writes a number as a factor between 1 and 10 times a power of 10. The exponent records the decimal shift.

oer.title: OpenStax Elementary Algebra 2e, 6.7 Integer Exponents and Scientific Notation

concepts.title: Polynomials
concepts.lesson: A polynomial is a sum of monomials with nonnegative integer exponents. Its degree is the largest exponent and its leading coefficient sits on that term.

oer.title: OpenStax Elementary Algebra 2e, 6.1 Add and Subtract Polynomials

concepts.title: Adding and Subtracting Polynomials
concepts.lesson: Add or subtract polynomials by combining like terms. Distribute a minus sign across every term of the polynomial being subtracted.

oer.title: OpenStax Elementary Algebra 2e, 6.1 Add and Subtract Polynomials

concepts.title: Multiplying Monomials
concepts.lesson: Multiply coefficients and add exponents of matching variable factors. Apply every exponent to each factor inside parentheses.

oer.title: OpenStax Elementary Algebra 2e, 6.3 Multiply Polynomials

concepts.title: Multiplying Binomials
concepts.lesson: Every term of the first binomial multiplies every term of the second. Combine like terms after all four products.

oer.title: OpenStax Elementary Algebra 2e, 6.3 Multiply Polynomials

concepts.title: Special Products
concepts.lesson: Squares of binomials follow (a+b)^2 = a^2 + 2ab + b^2, and conjugates follow (a+b)(a-b) = a^2 - b^2.

oer.title: OpenStax Elementary Algebra 2e, 6.4 Special Products

concepts.title: Greatest Common Factor
concepts.lesson: Factoring reverses distribution. Pull out the greatest common factor of every term first.

oer.title: OpenStax Elementary Algebra 2e, 7.1 Greatest Common Factor

concepts.title: Factoring Trinomials
concepts.lesson: Find two numbers whose product is the constant term and whose sum is the middle coefficient. Those numbers form the binomial factors.

oer.title: OpenStax Elementary Algebra 2e, 7.2 Factor Trinomials of the Form x^2 + bx + c

concepts.title: Difference of Squares
concepts.lesson: A difference of two squares factors as (a+b)(a-b). Check for a common factor before applying the pattern.

oer.title: OpenStax Elementary Algebra 2e, 7.4 Factor Special Products

concepts.title: General Factoring Strategy
concepts.lesson: Always try the greatest common factor first, then count terms and choose a pattern. Keep factoring until every factor is prime.

oer.title: OpenStax Elementary Algebra 2e, 7.5 General Strategy for Factoring

concepts.title: Zero Product Property
concepts.lesson: If a product equals zero, at least one factor must be zero. This turns a factored equation into two simpler equations.

oer.title: OpenStax Elementary Algebra 2e, 7.6 Quadratic Equations

concepts.title: Solving Quadratics by Factoring
concepts.lesson: Move every term to one side, factor the quadratic, and set each factor equal to zero. Check each root in the original equation.

oer.title: OpenStax Elementary Algebra 2e, 7.6 Quadratic Equations

concepts.title: The Square Root Property
concepts.lesson: If x^2 = k, then x is the positive or negative square root of k. Include both signs when solving.

oer.title: OpenStax Elementary Algebra 2e, 10.1 The Square Root Property

concepts.title: The Quadratic Formula
concepts.lesson: For ax^2 + bx + c = 0, x = (-b +/- sqrt(b^2 - 4ac)) / (2a). The discriminant tells how many real solutions exist.

oer.title: OpenStax Elementary Algebra 2e, 10.3 The Quadratic Formula

concepts.title: Rational Expressions
concepts.lesson: A rational expression is a quotient of polynomials. Factor first, then cancel common factors, and note excluded denominator values.

oer.title: OpenStax Elementary Algebra 2e, 8.1 Simplify Rational Expressions

concepts.title: Relations and Functions
concepts.lesson: A function gives each input exactly one output. A relation that repeats an input with different outputs is not a function.

oer.title: OpenStax Intermediate Algebra 2e, 3.5 Relations and Functions

concepts.title: Function Notation
concepts.lesson: f(x) names the output of function f for input x. Evaluate it by substituting the input wherever x appears.

oer.title: OpenStax Intermediate Algebra 2e, 3.6 Graphs of Functions

concepts.title: Linear Functions
concepts.lesson: A linear function has a constant rate of change. Its graph is a line and its equation can be written in slope-intercept form.

oer.title: OpenStax Intermediate Algebra 2e, 3.6 Graphs of Functions

concepts.title: Linear Models
concepts.lesson: A linear model pairs a starting value with a constant rate. Interpret the slope and intercept in the units of the situation.

oer.title: OpenStax Intermediate Algebra 2e, 3.6 Graphs of Functions

concepts.title: Quadratic Graphs
concepts.lesson: A quadratic graph is a parabola. Its vertex is the highest or lowest point, and its axis of symmetry passes through the vertex.

oer.title: OpenStax Intermediate Algebra 2e, 9.6 Graph Quadratic Functions Using Properties

concepts.title: Exponential Functions
concepts.lesson: An exponential function multiplies by a constant factor for each step. Its graph grows or decays faster than a line.

oer.title: OpenStax Intermediate Algebra 2e, 10.2 Evaluate and Graph Exponential Functions

concepts.title: Sequences
concepts.lesson: A sequence is an ordered list whose terms follow a rule. An arithmetic sequence adds the same difference each step.

oer.title: OpenStax Intermediate Algebra 2e, 12.1 Sequences
